newsitem.title: USA: Juniata Valley School District, Pa., final details.
newsitem.headline: Juniata Valley School District, Pa., final details.

text.p: Public Financial Management, financial advisor to the Juniata Valley School District, Pa., said it adjusted the size of the issue and recalculated Prudential Securities Inc's winning bid. The issue has been decreased from $4.170 million to $4.150 million. Prudential's TIC is 5.0014 percent, reflecting the cost of bond insurance, not the 4.9752 percent originally calculated.
